description: Check what your own API key has spent, so you can decide mid-task whether to keep going. Reading it is free: it costs no quota. Optional `from` and `to` (YYYY-MM-DD UTC, inclusive, at most 92 days apart) bound the report; omitted, it covers the current month to date. Returns `days` (per-day, per-endpoint), `totals` per endpoint over the range, `total_units`, plus `month_used_units` against `monthly_quota_units` and the prepaid `balance_millipence` (thousandths of a penny). Everything is counted in UNITS — weighted quota units, where a heavier endpoint costs more than one unit per request — so never report these figures as a number of calls. When `identity_pooled` is true the quota is shared with the other keys belonging to the same owner, so these figures are not yours alone. The key that authenticates the call is the key reported on: there is no way to read another caller's usage. Needs the MapMap gateway (GATEWAY_URL + GATEWAY_API_KEY).

from.description:
First day to report, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC) inclusive. Defaults to the
first day of the current month. At most 92 days may separate
`from` and `to`.

to.description:
Last day to report, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC) inclusive. Defaults to
today.

name: get_usage

UsageDay.description: One day's usage, in units per endpoint.

endpoints.description: Units per endpoint on this day, heaviest first.

endpoint.description:
The endpoint label the meter records, e.g. `/route`, `/geocode`,
`/tiles`. Labels are collapsed by the meter, so several request
shapes can share one.

units.description: Weighted quota units, never a count of calls.

balance_millipence.description:
Prepaid balance in millipence (thousandths of a penny), for usage
beyond the monthly allowance.

days.description:
Per-day breakdown over the range, oldest first. A day with no
usage is absent rather than reported as zero.

identity_pooled.description:
Whether quota is pooled across every key belonging to the same
identity. When true, these figures are the identity's shared
consumption, so another key of the same owner also spends them.

key_id.description: Identifier of the key this usage belongs to.

month_used_units.description:
Units counted against the monthly quota right now: the very number
the quota check enforces on, independent of `from`/`to`. Quota is
monthly, so this — not `total_units` — is what to compare with
`monthly_quota_units`. It includes units recorded but not yet
written to the daily counters, so over a whole-month range it can
exceed `total_units`; that is not a discrepancy.

monthly_quota_units.description: The key's monthly allowance in units.

total_units.description: Total units over the whole range.

totals.description: Units per endpoint over the whole range.
